C1695.title: 74% of Enterprises Have Publicly Exposed Storage or Misconfigurations in the Cloud
C1695.summary: On October 8, 2024, Tenable released its 2024 Tenable Cloud Risk Report, which based on telemetry from its cloud security customers noted that 74% of organizations have publicly exposed storage assets (including those holding sensitive data), often due to unnecessary or excessive permissions, and linked this exposure to increased ransomware attacks. The report also revealed that 38% of organizations exhibit a 'toxic cloud triad' — cloud workloads that are simultaneously publicly exposed, critically vulnerable, and highly privileged, forming a high-risk attack path.
